summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing fiscal Q4 2026 results and a renewed normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 10% of public float. The board authorized the buyback, reflecting confidence in the company's balance sheet ($453.9M cash) and improving profitability (Adjusted EBITDA $15.1M, positive Adjusted Free Cash Flow for fiscal year). No price, premium, or expiry date specified; terms will be set by market conditions. This capital return mechanism aims to enhance shareholder value. Watch for actual repurchase cadence and potential impact on share price over the bid's duration.
